en: The First Book, The Chapter on the Non-Drinker (Apāyimha-vagga)
“For him by whom auspicious signs have been uprooted—omens, dreams, and bodily marks;”
"Thus, having transcended the faults of auspicious omens,
one who has attained the yoke of yoga does not come to birth again.
Thus ends the seventh Jātaka, the Maṅgala-jātaka.
